column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other in English, one form for Japanese.
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in neutral Japanese,
# using the terms Japanese-speaking users of creative software know. The user is addressed with
# the neutral polite form (です・ます), as in most current Japanese software.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft,
# WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft, SoundCraft, FigCraft), "GitHub", "Discord".
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc).
# Japanese has one plural form. Shown with the system's Japanese font (see cjk_font.rs); where the
# system has none, the interface stays in English.
